description: Create a layer at the top of the stack, or as a sublayer of parentLayer, with the Layer Options settings (Layers panel menu > New Layer, New Layer with Dialog)

color.description: Highlight colour of the layer's selections and outlines, "#RRGGBB" or "rgb(r,g,b)"

dimPlacedImages.description: Dim placed images on the layer (Dim Images to). Illustrator uses its own percentage; scripts cannot set it

preview.description: false shows the layer in Outline mode
